name: hermes-agent-bridge
description: Two-way messaging between Claude Code sessions and Hermes Agent sessions: Claude sends Hermes a message or work order and gets the reply in the same call (no open chat needed), Claude messages a running Hermes chat through its inbox, and Hermes asks idle Claude sessions for help through a ticket. Hardened for public use: a delete gate on Claude-originated work, validated refs, read-then-claim delivery, secret scrubbing, nonce-fenced peer data, a hop cap and pointer-only headless sends.
